chat-start.title: How Ask AI works
chat-start.body: Ask in plain words: the AI picks the tool, runs it on our data, and the backtest draws under the answer. QuantGPT's AI answers where your plan includes it; Use your own AI takes your own key.

chat-arm.title: QuantGPT's AI, or your own
chat-arm.body: QuantGPT's AI needs no key where your plan includes it. Or press Use your own AI and paste a key for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and more. It stays in this browser and goes only to your provider.

chat-try.title: Prompts to try
chat-try.body: Research questions members ask. Tap one and it goes straight to the AI. Swap in your own ticker or idea once you see how it answers.

chat-plan.title: Your plan
chat-plan.body: What your plan opens on the site, and its daily limit for Connect your AI calls. Tap a locked row to see the plan that opens it.

chat-rules.title: The rules
chat-rules.body: Our tools report what your rules would have done and which stocks pass them today. They are read only: none can place, change or cancel an order. Returns are gross of costs unless stated.
